'''Douglas Leon Mills''' (April 2, 1940 – March 29, 2012) was an American [[physicist]] and writer.

== Life and career ==
Mills as born in [[Berkeley, California]]. He attended the [[University of California, Berkeley]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BS degree]] in [[engineering physics]] in 1961 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in [[physics]] in 1965. After earning his degrees, he worked as a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]] at [[Paris-Sud University]] in [[Orsay]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://senate.universityofcalifornia.edu/_files/inmemoriam/html/DouglasLeonMills.html|title=Douglas Leon Millions|work=[[University of California|Academic Senate]]|access-date=August 13, 2026}}</ref>

Mills served as a professor in the department of [[physics]] at the [[University of California, Irvine]] from 1966 to 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.physics.uci.edu/news/memory-professor-douglas-l-mills|title=In Memory of Professor Douglas L. Mills|work=[[University of California, Irvine]]|date=April 16, 2012|access-date=August 13, 2026}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1972, he was named a [[Lists of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=mills&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=August 13, 2026}}</ref> and in 1991, he wrote the book ''Nonlinear Optics: Basic Concepts'', published by [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer-Velag]].<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books/about/Nonlinear_Optics.html?id=IwpBAQAAIAAJ|title=Nonlinear Optics: Basic Concepts|first=D. L.|last=Mills|publisher=Springer-Velag|date=1991|ISBN=9783540541929|via=[[Google Books]]}}</ref>

== Death ==
Mills died on March 29, 2012, in [[Duarte, California]], at the age of 71.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://physicstoday.aip.org/obituaries/douglas-leon-mills|title=Douglas Leon Mills|work=[[Physics Today]]|date=August 1, 2012|access-date=August 13, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/corona-del-mar-ca/douglas-mills-5052043|title=Douglas Leon Mills|work=Dignity Memorial|access-date=August 13, 2026}}</ref>
